pet_notes: A small friendly flat-vector studio buddy for a product designer who is learning to build: rounded teal body, warm cream face panel, expressive navy eyes, tiny coral pencil tucked behind one ear, compact whole-body silhouette, curious and quietly determined.
style_notes: Warm editorial product-design energy; simple bold shapes, crisp dark outline, no text, no logos, no scenery.
